input:
interstellar medium is turbulent with magnetic fields playing a critical role in the key processes , including star formation , propagation and acceleration of cosmic rays as well as regulating heat and mass transfer between different phases . 
 therefore it is essential to have a reliable way of studying magnetic fields . 
 unfortunately , there only a few ways of tracing magnetic fields and their applicability is limited . 
 for instance , tracing magnetic fields with aligned grains ( see @xcite ) requires either the availability of the background stars , if the polarization via extinction is employed , or sensitive far infrared measurements , which frequently imply the use of the space - based instruments . 
 another major technique that employs synchrotron polarization mostly traces magnetic fields in the warm and hot phases of the interstellar medium ( ism ) ( see @xcite for the list of the idealised ism phases ) .    using spectroscopic data for tracing magnetic fields 
 was first suggested and demonstrated in @xcite using the anisotropy of correlation functions of the velocity channel maps . 
 the new approach was motivated by the theoretical advancements establishing that the mhd turbulence is anisotropic ( @xcite , herafter gs95 , @xcite , see @xcite for a review ) and should translate into the anisotropy of the observed correlation fluctuations . 
 later this approach was employed with the use of velocity centroids @xcite and @xcite and the principal component analysis ( pca ) @xcite of the spectroscopic data . in its pca incarnation 
 the idea of tracing magnetic field anisotropies was applied to the observational data in @xcite with the results of anisotropies shown to be consistent with the starlight polarization measurements . 
 further development of the technique resulted in the development of techniques using the anisotropies for obtaining the media magnetization , as it parameterized by the alfven mach number @xcite and the separation of compressib...
output:
this study proceeds with the development of the technique employing velocity gradients that were identified in ( @xcite , henceforth gl17 ) as a means of probing magnetic field in interstellar media . 
 we demonstrate a number of practical ways on improving the accuracy of tracing magnetic fields in diffuse interstellar media using velocity centroid gradients ( vcgs ) . addressing the magnetic field tracing in super - alfvenic turbulence 
 we introduce the procedure of filtering low spatial frequencies , that enables magnetic field tracing in the situations when the kinetic energy of turbulent plasmas dominate its magnetic energy . 
 we propose the synergic way of of using vcgs together with intensity gradients ( igs ) , synchrotron intensity gradients ( sigs ) as well as dust polarimetry . 
 we show that while the igs trace magnetic field worse than the vcgs , the deviations of the angle between the igs and vcgs trace the shocks in diffuse media . 
 similarly the perpendicular orientation of the vcgs and the sigs or to the dust polarimetry data trace the regions of gravitational collapse . 
 we demonstrate the utility of combining the vcgs , igs and polarimetry using galfa hi and planck polarimetry data . 
 we also provide an example of synergy of the vcgs and the sigs using the hi4pi full - sky hi survey together with the planck synchrotron intensity data .

instruction: 将下文译为英文，注意专业术语的准确性。
input: 图像生成模型旨在从数据分布中学习高维视觉表示，并合成具有统计一致性的图像。传统方法以变分自编码器（VAE）和生成对抗网络（GAN）为代表，分别通过最大化证据下界与对抗博弈逼近真实分布。近年来，扩散模型结合U-Net与自注意力，在逐步去噪过程中建模条件概率，具备稳定训练和高保真生成的优势。配合文本编码器与CLIP对齐，可实现跨模态条件生成。模型评估通常采用FID、IS等指标，并关注多样性、保真度与可控性之间的权衡。
output: Image generation models aim to learn high-dimensional visual representations from data distributions and synthesize images with statistical consistency. Traditional approaches are represented by Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), which approximate the true data distribution by maximizing the evidence lower bound and through adversarial games, respectively. In recent years, diffusion models, combining U-Net architectures with self-attention, model conditional probabilities during a progressive denoising process, offering advantages in training stability and high-fidelity generation. When coupled with text encoders and CLIP alignment, they enable cross-modal conditional generation. instruction: 中文翻译：
input: Edge computing inference refers to the execution of machine learning or deep learning models directly on edge devices, such as embedded systems, IoT nodes, or edge servers, rather than relying on centralized cloud infrastructure. This paradigm aims to minimize end-to-end latency, reduce network bandwidth consumption, and enhance data privacy by processing data closer to its source. Technically, edge inference involves optimizing models to operate under constrained computational resources, limited memory, and strict power budgets. Common techniques include model compression, quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, and hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS). Additionally, specialized accelerators such as NPUs, TPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs are often leveraged to improve inference throughput and energy efficiency. From a systems perspective, edge inference requires tight integration between software frameworks (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TensorFlow Lite) and heterogeneous hardware platforms, as well as efficient runtime scheduling and memory management. Challenges such as model update mechanisms, version control, fault tolerance, and real-time performance guarantees are critical in large-scale deployments. Furthermore, edge inference plays a pivotal role in latency-sensitive and mission-critical applications, including autonomous driving, industrial automation, smart surveillance, and augmented reality. As AI models continue to grow in complexity, research in edge inference increasingly focuses on co-design strategies that jointly optimize algorithms, hardware, and system software to achieve scalable, robust, and energy-efficient intelligent systems at the network edge.
output:
边缘计算推理（Edge computing inference）是指在边缘设备（如嵌入式系统、物联网节点或边缘服务器）上直接执行机器学习或深度学习模型，而非依赖集中式的云端基础设施。该范式旨在通过将数据处理靠近数据源来最小化端到端延迟、降低网络带宽消耗，并增强数据隐私保护。

从技术角度来看，边缘推理需要对模型进行优化，使其能够在受限的计算资源、有限的内存以及严格的功耗预算条件下运行。常见的技术手段包括模型压缩、量化（quantization）、剪枝（pruning）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）以及硬件感知的神经架构搜索（hardware-aware neural architecture search，NAS）。此外，通常会利用专用加速器，如 NPU、TPU、GPU 和 FPGA，以提升推理吞吐量和能效比。

从系统层面看，边缘推理要求软件框架（如 TensorRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorFlow Lite）与异构硬件平台之间实现紧密集成，同时还需要高效的运行时调度与内存管理。在大规模部署中，模型更新机制、版本控制、容错能力以及实时性能保障等问题至关重要。

此外，边缘推理在对时延高度敏感和任务关键型应用中发挥着核心作用，包括自动驾驶、工业自动化、智能监控和增强现实等领域。随着 AI 模型复杂度的不断提升，边缘推理研究正日益聚焦于协同设计（co-design）策略，通过联合优化算法、硬件和系统软件，在网络边缘实现可扩展、鲁棒且高能效的智能系统。

instruction: Help me translate this to English.
input: MLOps实践旨在将机器学习模型的研发、部署与运维流程工程化与自动化，以提升模型生命周期管理的可重复性与可靠性。其核心包括数据版本控制、特征工程流水线、模型训练与评估的持续集成（CI），以及在线/离线推理的持续交付（CD）。通过引入模型注册表、实验追踪、A/B测试与灰度发布机制，MLOps能够实现模型性能监控、漂移检测与回滚策略。结合容器化与Kubernetes编排，MLOps在保障可扩展性与资源隔离的同时，促进跨团队协作与合规审计。
output: MLOps practices aim to engineer and automate the research, development, deployment, and operations of machine learning models, thereby improving the reproducibility and reliability of model lifecycle management. Its core components include data version control, feature engineering pipelines, continuous integration (CI) for model training and evaluation, and continuous delivery (CD) for online and offline inference. instruction: 请总结以下技术文档的核心内容。
input:
Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising paradigm to address the growing tension between data-driven machine learning and stringent data privacy, governance, and sovereignty requirements. Traditional centralized learning relies on aggregating raw data from distributed sources into a central server, which raises concerns related to privacy leakage, regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR and HIPAA), and communication overhead. In domains such as healthcare, finance, and edge intelligence, data are inherently decentralized and sensitive, making centralized training impractical or even prohibited. Federated learning reframes this problem by enabling collaborative model training without requiring direct access to local data.

In a typical federated learning setting, a global model is initialized and distributed to a large number of clients, such as mobile devices, hospitals, or edge nodes. Each client performs local training using its private dataset and computes model updates, often in the form of gradients or weight deltas. These updates are then transmitted to a central coordinator, which aggregates them—commonly via the Federated Averaging (FedAvg) algorithm—to produce an improved global model. This process is iterative and continues until convergence. From a systems perspective, FL must cope with statistical heterogeneity (non-IID data distributions), system heterogeneity (varying computation and network capabilities), and partial client participation.

To enhance privacy guarantees, federated learning is frequently combined with cryptographic and statistical techniques. Secure aggregation protocols ensure that the server can only observe aggregated updates rather than individual client contributions, mitigating the risk of information leakage. Differential privacy can be applied by injecting calibrated noise into local updates or aggregated parameters, providing formal privacy bounds against inference attacks such as membership inference or model inversion. Recent research has also explored personalized federated learning, multi-task learning formulations, and adaptive optimization methods (e.g., FedProx, Scaffold) to address client drift and improve convergence under heterogeneous data distributions.

Empirical studies demonstrate that federated learning can achieve model performance comparable to centralized training while significantly reducing privacy risks and data transfer costs. However, FL introduces new challenges, including increased communication rounds, vulnerability to poisoning and backdoor attacks, and difficulties in debugging and evaluation due to the lack of centralized data visibility. Ongoing advances in communication-efficient optimization, robust aggregation, and trustworthy FL aim to address these limitations.

In conclusion, federated learning represents a fundamental shift in how machine learning systems are designed and deployed in privacy-sensitive, large-scale environments. By decoupling model training from raw data collection, FL provides a scalable and privacy-aware solution that aligns technical innovation with regulatory and ethical constraints, making it a cornerstone technology for the next generation of distributed artificial intelligence systems.
output: 联邦学习通过在本地训练并聚合模型更新（如FedAvg），实现无需集中数据的协同建模，适用于隐私敏感的分布式场景。其结合安全聚合与差分隐私保障数据安全，但仍面临异构性、通信开销及鲁棒性等挑战。

instruction: Help me translate this to English.
input: 大语言模型的训练通常采用基于Transformer架构的自监督学习范式。首先对大规模多源语料进行清洗与分词，将文本映射为离散token，并以自回归的下一词预测作为核心目标函数。训练过程中使用AdamW优化器、学习率预热与衰减策略，以及混合精度和数据并行、模型并行以提升效率与稳定性。预训练完成后，通过指令微调、参数高效微调或基于人类反馈的强化学习对齐模型行为，从而在保持泛化能力的同时增强任务适应性与安全性。
output: The training of large language models typically adopts a self-supervised learning paradigm based on the Transformer architecture. During training, the AdamW optimizer is used together with learning rate warm-up and decay strategies, as well as mixed-precision training and data parallelism and model parallelism to improve efficiency and stability. instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
在深度神经网络训练中，反向传播计算得到的梯度可能因网络深度、参数初始化或数据分布不稳定而出现梯度爆炸，导致损失震荡、数值溢出甚至训练失败。为缓解这一问题，梯度裁剪方法被广泛用于优化过程，作为对梯度范数的约束机制。

常见方案包括按值裁剪与按范数裁剪。按值裁剪直接将每个梯度分量限制在预设区间内，实现简单但可能破坏梯度方向；按范数裁剪则在梯度整体范数超过阈值时按比例缩放，保持方向一致性，因此在循环神经网络和大模型训练中更为常用。进一步的改进方法如自适应梯度裁剪（AGC），通过比较参数范数与梯度范数来自适应设定裁剪尺度，减少对有效学习信号的干扰。

实践表明，合理的梯度裁剪能够显著提升训练稳定性，与Adam、SGD等优化器兼容良好，尤其在长序列建模和混合精度训练中效果明显。但阈值选择需结合模型规模与学习率调节。总体而言，梯度裁剪是一种低成本且有效的稳定化技术，是深度学习训练流程中的重要组成部分。
output: 梯度裁剪用于缓解深度网络训练中的梯度爆炸，通过限制梯度幅度提升稳定性。按值裁剪简单但易破坏方向，按范数裁剪更常用；AGC进一步自适应控制裁剪尺度。其与主流优化器兼容，在长序列和混合精度训练中效果显著。

instruction: 请将以下英文内容译为中文，保持专业术语准确。
input: Few-shot learning (FSL) addresses the challenge of training models that can generalize to novel tasks or classes using only a limited number of labeled examples, which is critical in domains where data acquisition is expensive or impractical. At its core, FSL aims to mitigate overfitting and improve sample efficiency by leveraging prior knowledge learned from related tasks. Prominent approaches include metric-based methods, such as prototypical networks and matching networks, which learn an embedding space where classification can be performed via distance-based similarity measures. Optimization-based approaches, exemplified by Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), seek to learn model parameters or initializations that can be rapidly adapted to new tasks with a few gradient updates. Bayesian formulations further incorporate uncertainty estimation and prior distributions to enhance robustness under data scarcity. Episodic training is commonly employed to simulate the few-shot setting during meta-training, thereby aligning training and inference conditions. Recent advances integrate representation learning from large-scale pretraining or foundation models to provide strong inductive biases, significantly improving generalization in low-data regimes. Additionally, techniques such as data augmentation, task conditioning, and hierarchical priors have been explored to further enhance performance. Overall, few-shot learning represents a convergence of meta-learning, transfer learning, and probabilistic modeling, offering a principled framework for building adaptive and data-efficient intelligent systems.
output: 小样本学习（Few-shot Learning，FSL）旨在解决仅利用极少量标注样本即可训练模型，并使其能够泛化到新任务或新类别的挑战，这在数据获取成本高昂或难以实现的领域尤为关键。从本质上看，FSL 通过利用从相关任务中学到的先验知识，缓解过拟合问题并提升样本效率。代表性方法包括基于度量的方法，如原型网络（Prototypical Networks）和匹配网络（Matching Networks），它们学习一个嵌入空间，在该空间中可通过基于距离的相似性度量来完成分类。基于优化的方法以模型无关元学习（Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning，MAML）为代表，旨在学习模型参数或初始化，使其能够通过少量梯度更新快速适应新任务。贝叶斯方法进一步引入不确定性估计和先验分布，以在数据稀缺的情况下增强模型的鲁棒性。在元训练阶段，通常采用情景式训练（Episodic Training）来模拟小样本设置，从而对齐训练与推理条件。近年来的研究将大规模预训练或基础模型（Foundation Models）中的表征学习引入 FSL，为模型提供强归纳偏置，显著提升了低数据场景下的泛化能力。此外，数据增强、任务条件化以及层次化先验等技术也被广泛探索，以进一步提升性能。总体而言，小样本学习体现了元学习、迁移学习与概率建模的融合，为构建具有自适应能力且数据高效的智能系统提供了一种系统化且有理论依据的框架。

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
在机器学习与数据挖掘任务中，特征工程直接决定模型性能上限，其目标是在有限样本与噪声条件下，构造具有判别力和稳定性的特征表示。实际问题中，原始数据往往存在维度高、分布不一致、缺失严重及语义弱等问题，若直接建模，容易导致过拟合或泛化能力不足。因此，系统化的特征工程方法成为建模流程中的关键环节。  
常见方法可分为特征清洗、特征变换、特征构造与特征选择四类。在清洗阶段，需进行缺失值处理、异常检测及一致性校验，以降低数据噪声；在变换阶段，常用标准化、归一化、分箱、对数变换等手段改善特征分布，并通过独热编码、目标编码或嵌入表示处理类别特征。特征构造强调引入领域知识，如交叉特征、统计聚合特征、时间窗口特征以及文本中的TF-IDF或词向量表示，以增强语义表达能力。特征选择则通过过滤式、包裹式和嵌入式方法减少冗余维度，典型技术包括卡方检验、互信息、L1正则化、树模型重要性评估及PCA等降维方法。  
在实践中，特征工程需与模型选择和交叉验证协同设计，避免数据泄露并平衡偏差与方差。合理的特征工程通常能在不显著增加模型复杂度的前提下，提高预测精度、训练效率与模型可解释性，是构建高质量智能系统的重要基础。
output: 特征工程决定模型性能上限，通过清洗、变换、构造与选择提升特征判别力与稳定性。结合领域知识与统计方法，可降低噪声和冗余，在避免数据泄露的前提下提升模型精度、效率与可解释性。

instruction: 请将以下AI相关内容翻译成英文。
input: 情感分析算法是自然语言处理中的核心任务，旨在从文本中识别情绪极性与强度。传统方法基于情感词典与规则推理，依赖人工构建的极性权重，泛化能力有限。监督式机器学习通过特征工程与分类器建模，如TF‑IDF、SVM和朴素贝叶斯。近年来，深度学习方法利用词向量、LSTM、CNN及Transformer（如BERT）的上下文表示与注意力机制，实现端到端建模，并支持方面级情感分析。模型通常以准确率、F1值评估，并需处理噪声、讽刺与领域迁移问题。
output: Sentiment analysis algorithms are a core task in natural language processing, aiming to identify the polarity and intensity of emotions expressed in text. Traditional approaches rely on sentiment lexicons and rule-based reasoning, depending on manually constructed polarity weights and exhibiting limited generalization capability. Supervised machine learning methods perform modeling through feature engineering and classifiers, such as TF‑IDF, SVM, and Naive Bayes. In recent years, deep learning approaches have leveraged word embeddings, LSTM, CNN, and contextual representations and attention mechanisms of Transformers (e.g., BERT) to achieve end-to-end modeling and support aspect-level sentiment analysis. Models are typically evaluated using metrics such as accuracy and F1 score, and must address challenges including noise, sarcasm, and domain adaptation.

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
In-context learning (ICL) refers to the ability of large language models (LLMs) to acquire task-specific behavior at inference time by conditioning on a small set of input–output examples provided in the prompt, without updating model parameters. This phenomenon challenges the traditional supervised learning paradigm, where generalization is achieved through gradient-based optimization over labeled datasets. As LLMs have scaled in parameter count and training data, ICL has emerged as a central capability enabling rapid task adaptation, few-shot learning, and flexible deployment across domains.

The technical foundation of in-context learning lies in the pretraining of transformer-based models on large corpora using self-supervised objectives, typically next-token prediction. During pretraining, models are exposed to diverse linguistic patterns, including implicit task demonstrations, such as question–answer pairs, code snippets, and structured data transformations. At inference time, the prompt functions as a temporary context window in which examples implicitly define a task. The model leverages its attention mechanism to identify correspondences between inputs and outputs, infer latent task representations, and generate appropriate completions for new queries. Importantly, this process does not involve parameter updates; adaptation occurs entirely through activations and attention over the context.

Several theoretical frameworks have been proposed to explain ICL. One line of work interprets in-context learning as a form of amortized meta-learning, where the model has implicitly learned a learning algorithm during pretraining. Another perspective models ICL as approximate Bayesian inference, in which the prompt provides evidence used to update a posterior over latent task variables. Empirical studies show that ICL performance improves with model scale, prompt length, and example quality, consistent with known neural scaling laws. Prompt engineering techniques, such as example ordering, formatting consistency, and the use of natural language instructions, further influence the effectiveness of in-context learning by shaping the inductive biases expressed through attention patterns.

Despite its strengths, in-context learning has notable limitations. Performance can be highly sensitive to prompt design, and models may exhibit instability or failure modes when prompts contain noise, adversarial examples, or distributional shifts. Additionally, ICL does not provide persistent learning: knowledge acquired from one prompt does not transfer to subsequent interactions unless explicitly included again. Computational constraints, particularly context window length and inference cost, also limit the number and complexity of examples that can be provided.

In conclusion, in-context learning represents a paradigm shift in how machine learning systems adapt to new tasks, emphasizing inference-time conditioning over explicit retraining. It enables flexible, low-latency adaptation and underpins many practical applications of modern LLMs. Ongoing research aims to improve the robustness, interpretability, and theoretical grounding of ICL, as well as to integrate it more effectively with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and external memory systems.
output: 上下文学习指LLM在推理时仅依赖提示中的少量示例、无需参数更新即可适应任务。其基于预训练与注意力，在提示中推断任务；可视为隐式元学习或近似贝叶斯推断。性能随规模与提示工程提升，但对提示敏感、无持久学习且受上下文限制。

instruction: Translate to English:
input: 特征工程是机器学习建模中的关键环节，旨在通过对原始数据的构造、变换与选择，提升模型的泛化性能。常用方法包括数值特征的标准化与归一化、离散特征的独热编码与目标编码、时间与文本特征的统计汇总与嵌入表示，以及缺失值的机制分析与插补。特征选择可采用过滤法（如互信息、卡方检验）、包裹法（递归特征消除）与嵌入法（L1正则化、树模型重要性），以降低维度与过拟合风险。特征变换方面，PCA、ICA及非线性核映射可缓解多重共线性。全过程需结合领域知识，严格避免数据泄漏，并通过交叉验证评估特征增益。
output: Feature engineering is a critical stage in machine learning modeling, aiming to improve a model’s generalization performance through the construction, transformation, and selection of raw data features. Common approaches include standardization and normalization of numerical features; one-hot encoding and target encoding for categorical features; statistical aggregation and embedding representations for temporal and textual features; and analysis of missing-data mechanisms along with imputation. Feature selection can be performed using filter methods (such as mutual information and chi-square tests), wrapper methods (recursive feature elimination), and embedded methods (L1 regularization and tree-based model feature importance) to reduce dimensionality and mitigate overfitting. In terms of feature transformation, PCA, ICA, and nonlinear kernel mappings can alleviate multicollinearity. Throughout the process, domain knowledge should be incorporated, data leakage must be strictly avoided, and feature gains should be evaluated via cross-validation.

instruction: Translate to Chinese:
input: The design of a question answering (QA) system requires the integration of multiple components spanning natural language processing, information retrieval, and machine learning. At a high level, a modern QA system typically adopts a pipeline or end-to-end architecture that includes query understanding, knowledge acquisition, answer inference, and response generation. Query understanding involves tasks such as tokenization, syntactic parsing, semantic parsing, and intent detection to transform raw user input into a structured representation. Knowledge acquisition may rely on unstructured text corpora, structured databases, or knowledge graphs, often accessed through retrieval mechanisms such as dense vector search or hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and neural embeddings. In retrieval-based QA systems, candidate documents or passages are ranked using relevance models, followed by a reader component—often based on transformer architectures—that performs answer extraction or span prediction. Generative QA systems further incorporate large language models to synthesize answers, requiring careful prompt design, context window management, and hallucination mitigation. System design must also address scalability, latency, and robustness, particularly in real-world deployments. Evaluation is conducted using both automatic metrics (e.g., Exact Match, F1-score) and human judgment to assess factual accuracy and answer usefulness. Overall, effective QA system design demands a principled balance between linguistic modeling, efficient retrieval, and reliable reasoning capabilities.
output: 问答（QA）系统的设计需要集成多个组件，涵盖自然语言处理、信息检索和机器学习等领域。从宏观上看，现代 QA 系统通常采用流水线式或端到端架构，包括查询理解、知识获取、答案推理和响应生成等阶段。查询理解涉及分词、句法解析、语义解析和意图识别等任务，旨在将原始用户输入转换为结构化表示。知识获取可以依赖非结构化文本语料、结构化数据库或知识图谱，通常通过稠密向量检索或结合 BM25 与神经嵌入的混合检索机制来访问。在基于检索的 QA 系统中，候选文档或段落首先通过相关性模型进行排序，随后由阅读器组件——通常基于 Transformer 架构——执行答案抽取或跨度预测。生成式 QA 系统进一步引入大语言模型来合成答案，这需要精心设计提示（prompt）、管理上下文窗口，并采取措施缓解幻觉问题。系统设计还必须关注可扩展性、时延和鲁棒性，尤其是在真实世界的部署场景中。评估通常结合自动化指标（如 Exact Match、F1-score）和人工评估，以衡量事实准确性和答案的实用性。总体而言，高效的 QA 系统设计需要在语言建模、高效检索和可靠推理能力之间取得合理平衡。

instruction: 把这段话翻成中文。
input: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a fundamental sequence labeling task in natural language processing that aims to identify and classify spans of text into predefined semantic categories such as person, organization, location, time, or domain-specific entities. Formally, NER is often modeled as a structured prediction problem over token sequences, commonly using tagging schemes such as BIO or BILOU to encode entity boundaries. Early approaches relied on rule-based systems and probabilistic graphical models, including Hidden Markov Models and Conditional Random Fields (CRFs), which leveraged handcrafted lexical, orthographic, and syntactic features. Contemporary NER systems predominantly employ neural architectures, particularly BiLSTM-CRF models and Transformer-based encoders, which utilize contextualized word representations to capture long-range dependencies and semantic nuances. Pretrained language models such as BERT, RoBERTa, and XLM-R have significantly advanced the state of the art by enabling transfer learning across domains and languages. NER can be formulated as token-level classification or span-based prediction, each with different trade-offs in handling nested or overlapping entities. Model performance is typically evaluated using precision, recall, and F1-score under exact span matching criteria. Despite substantial progress, NER remains challenging due to issues such as entity ambiguity, domain shift, low-resource settings, annotation inconsistency, and the long-tail distribution of entity types, motivating ongoing research in robust learning and adaptation techniques.
output: 命名实体识别（Named Entity Recognition，NER）是自然语言处理中的一项基础序列标注任务，旨在识别并将文本片段分类到预定义的语义类别中，例如人名、组织机构名、地名、时间或特定领域的实体。从形式上看，NER 通常被建模为针对词元序列的结构化预测问题，常采用 BIO 或 BILOU 等标注方案来编码实体边界。早期方法主要依赖基于规则的系统和概率图模型，包括隐马尔可夫模型（Hidden Markov Models）和条件随机场（Conditional Random Fields，CRFs），这些方法利用人工设计的词汇、正字法和句法特征。现代 NER 系统则以神经网络架构为主，尤其是 BiLSTM-CRF 模型和基于 Transformer 的编码器，它们通过上下文化的词表示来捕获长程依赖关系和细粒度语义信息。BERT、RoBERTa 和 XLM-R 等预训练语言模型通过实现跨领域和跨语言的迁移学习，显著推动了该领域的最新进展。NER 可以被建模为词元级分类或基于跨度的预测，两种建模方式在处理嵌套或重叠实体时各有取舍。模型性能通常在严格的实体跨度完全匹配标准下，使用精确率（precision）、召回率（recall）和 F1 值进行评估。尽管已经取得了显著进展，NER 仍然面临诸多挑战，例如实体歧义、领域迁移、低资源场景、标注不一致性以及实体类型的长尾分布问题，这些问题持续推动着鲁棒学习与自适应技术方面的研究。

instruction: 将以下中文技术文档翻译成英文。
input: 分布式训练框架通过在多节点、多加速器环境中协同执行深度模型训练，以提升吞吐与可扩展性。其核心机制包括数据并行、模型并行与流水并行，依托AllReduce或参数服务器实现梯度聚合与一致性更新。框架通常集成高效通信库（如NCCL、RDMA），并提供自动切分、调度与容错能力，以降低通信开销与尾延迟。同时，通过一致性语义、混合精度、弹性伸缩与检查点机制，保障大规模训练的稳定性与可复现性。
output: Distributed training frameworks improve throughput and scalability by coordinating deep model training across multi-node, multi-accelerator environments. Their core mechanisms include data parallelism, model parallelism, and pipeline parallelism, relying on AllReduce or parameter servers to perform gradient aggregation and consistent updates. These frameworks typically integrate high-performance communication libraries (e.g., NCCL, RDMA) and provide automatic partitioning, scheduling, and fault tolerance to reduce communication overhead and tail latency. In addition, through consistency semantics, mixed precision, elastic scaling, and checkpointing mechanisms, they ensure the stability and reproducibility of large-scale training.

instruction: Translate the following CS paper abstract into Chinese.
input: The Vision Transformer (ViT) is a neural architecture that adapts the Transformer paradigm, originally developed for natural language processing, to visual understanding tasks by modeling images as sequences of patch embeddings. In ViT, an input image is partitioned into fixed-size non-overlapping patches, which are linearly projected into a latent embedding space and augmented with learnable positional encodings to preserve spatial information. These embeddings are then processed by a stack of Transformer encoder layers composed of multi-head self-attention (MHSA) and feed-forward multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), enabling global receptive fields and long-range dependency modeling across the entire image. Unlike convolutional neural networks (CNNs), ViT lacks strong inductive biases such as locality and translation equivariance, which makes it more data-hungry but also more scalable and flexible when trained on large-scale datasets. The self-attention mechanism allows ViT to dynamically weight interactions between distant image regions, offering advantages in tasks requiring global context. However, the quadratic computational complexity of self-attention with respect to the number of patches poses efficiency challenges for high-resolution images. To address these limitations, numerous variants have been proposed, including hybrid CNN-Transformer models, data-efficient training strategies (e.g., DeiT), and hierarchical architectures such as Swin Transformer that incorporate window-based attention to improve scalability. Overall, Vision Transformers represent a paradigm shift in computer vision, demonstrating competitive or superior performance across classification, detection, and segmentation tasks.
output: 视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer，ViT）是一种神经网络架构，它将最初为自然语言处理开发的 Transformer 范式引入到视觉理解任务中，通过将图像建模为一系列图像块嵌入来实现。在 ViT 中，输入图像被划分为固定大小且互不重叠的图像块，这些图像块通过线性投影映射到潜在的嵌入空间，并加入可学习的位置编码以保留空间信息。随后，这些嵌入被送入由多层 Transformer 编码器组成的堆叠结构中，编码器由多头自注意力（multi-head self-attention，MHSA）和前馈多层感知机（feed-forward multilayer perceptrons，MLPs）构成，从而实现全局感受野并建模整幅图像范围内的长程依赖关系。与卷积神经网络（CNN）不同，ViT 缺乏诸如局部性和平移等变性等强归纳偏置，这使其对数据规模的需求更高，但在大规模数据集上训练时也表现出更好的可扩展性和灵活性。自注意力机制使 ViT 能够动态地为远距离图像区域之间的交互分配权重，在需要全局上下文的信息任务中具有明显优势。然而，自注意力在图像块数量维度上的二次计算复杂度给高分辨率图像带来了效率方面的挑战。为了解决这些限制，研究者提出了多种变体，包括混合 CNN-Transformer 模型、数据高效的训练策略（如 DeiT），以及诸如 Swin Transformer 的分层架构，通过引入基于窗口的注意力机制来提升可扩展性。总体而言，视觉 Transformer 代表了计算机视觉领域的一次范式转变，在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割等任务中展现出具有竞争力甚至优于传统方法的性能。

instruction: Translate the following Chinese text into English.
input: 语义分割方法旨在对图像中每个像素进行语义级标注，是计算机视觉中的核心任务。传统方法以全卷积网络（FCN）为基础，通过将分类网络改造为端到端的像素预测模型，实现密集预测。随后，编码器—解码器结构被广泛采用，如U-Net、SegNet，通过下采样提取高层语义特征，并结合跳跃连接恢复空间分辨率。近年来，引入空洞卷积、多尺度特征融合与注意力机制以扩大感受野并增强上下文建模能力；同时，基于Transformer的语义分割模型利用自注意力捕获长程依赖。在训练层面，常结合交叉熵、Dice或IoU损失函数，并在Cityscapes等数据集上以mIoU作为主要评估指标。
output: Semantic segmentation aims to assign a semantic-level label to every pixel in an image and is a core task in computer vision. Traditional approaches are based on Fully Convolutional Networks (FCNs), which transform classification networks into end-to-end pixel-wise prediction models to achieve dense prediction. Subsequently, encoder–decoder architectures have been widely adopted, such as U-Net and SegNet, which extract high-level semantic features through downsampling and restore spatial resolution via skip connections. In recent years, dilated convolutions, multi-scale feature fusion, and attention mechanisms have been introduced to enlarge the receptive field and enhance contextual modeling capability; meanwhile, Transformer-based semantic segmentation models leverage self-attention to capture long-range dependencies. At the training level, cross-entropy, Dice, or IoU loss functions are commonly combined, and mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) is used as the primary evaluation metric on datasets such as Cityscapes.

instruction: 将下面这段计算机领域的学术摘要翻译成中文。
input: In-context learning (ICL) refers to the ability of large language models to adapt their behavior at inference time by conditioning on a sequence of examples, instructions, or demonstrations provided within the prompt, without updating model parameters. Unlike traditional supervised fine-tuning, ICL operates through prompt-based conditioning, where the model infers task structure, input-output mappings, and latent rules directly from the context. Empirical evidence suggests that ICL emerges as a function of scale, with larger models exhibiting stronger few-shot and zero-shot generalization. From a mechanistic perspective, ICL has been interpreted as implicit meta-learning, where the model approximates an inner-loop learning algorithm through its forward pass, potentially implementing Bayesian inference or nearest-neighbor–like retrieval over representations. Research has shown that attention mechanisms play a critical role by enabling pattern induction, example binding, and task segmentation within the context window. However, ICL is sensitive to prompt design, example ordering, and distributional alignment between demonstrations and test queries, raising concerns about robustness and reliability. Limitations include finite context length, susceptibility to spurious correlations, and degraded performance under distribution shift. Ongoing work explores augmentations such as retrieval-augmented generation, structured prompting, and tool use to enhance ICL efficacy, as well as theoretical analyses to formalize its inductive biases and generalization properties.
output:
上下文学习（In-context learning，ICL）是指大型语言模型在推理阶段通过对提示中提供的一系列示例、指令或演示进行条件化，从而在不更新模型参数的情况下调整自身行为的能力。不同于传统的有监督微调，ICL 通过基于提示的条件化机制运行，模型直接从上下文中推断任务结构、输入-输出映射以及潜在规则。大量实证证据表明，ICL 随着模型规模的扩大而逐渐显现，规模更大的模型在小样本（few-shot）和零样本（zero-shot）泛化方面表现出更强的能力。

从机理角度看，ICL 常被解释为一种隐式的元学习（meta-learning），即模型在前向传播过程中近似实现了一个内循环学习算法，可能体现为贝叶斯推断或类似最近邻检索的表示操作。研究表明，attention 机制在其中发挥着关键作用，使模型能够在上下文窗口内完成模式归纳、示例绑定以及任务分割。然而，ICL 对提示设计、示例顺序以及演示样本与测试查询之间的分布对齐高度敏感，这引发了对其鲁棒性和可靠性的担忧。其局限性还包括有限的上下文长度、对虚假相关性的敏感性，以及在分布发生偏移时性能下降等问题。

当前的研究工作正在探索多种增强手段以提升 ICL 的有效性，例如检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation）、结构化提示（structured prompting）以及工具使用（tool use），同时也通过理论分析来形式化刻画 ICL 的归纳偏置和泛化性质。

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
The Transformer architecture has become the dominant paradigm for sequence modeling in natural language processing, vision, and multimodal learning due to its strong representation capacity and parallelizable self-attention mechanism. However, as model sizes and input lengths scale, Transformers face significant challenges in computational complexity, memory consumption, and training stability. In particular, the quadratic time and space complexity of standard self-attention with respect to sequence length, along with rapidly growing parameter counts, has motivated extensive research into architectural and system-level optimizations.

A major line of optimization focuses on improving the efficiency of the attention mechanism. Sparse attention variants restrict each token’s receptive field using fixed or learned patterns, reducing complexity while preserving long-range dependencies. Linear attention methods approximate softmax attention through kernelization or low-rank factorization, achieving linear complexity at the cost of approximation error. More recently, memory-efficient exact attention implementations, such as FlashAttention, reorganize computation to minimize memory bandwidth usage and exploit GPU SRAM, yielding substantial speedups without altering model semantics. In parallel, positional encoding schemes like Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) and ALiBi improve extrapolation to long sequences while avoiding the overhead of learned absolute embeddings.

Another important direction is parameter efficiency and model capacity optimization. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures conditionally activate a subset of parameters per token, enabling trillion-parameter models with manageable computation. Low-rank adaptation, parameter sharing, and tensor factorization further reduce redundancy in attention and feed-forward layers. Post-training compression techniques, including structured pruning, quantization-aware training, and knowledge distillation, significantly lower inference latency and memory footprint while maintaining accuracy. These approaches are particularly relevant for deploying Transformers on edge devices or under strict latency constraints.

Training stability and scalability are also critical optimization targets. Architectural refinements such as Pre-Layer Normalization improve gradient flow in deep Transformers, enabling stable training at hundreds of layers. Optimizer and scheduler choices, including adaptive optimizers with decoupled weight decay and cosine learning rate schedules, have become standard practice. At the system level, data, model, and pipeline parallelism, combined with activation checkpointing, allow efficient training across large-scale distributed environments.

Overall, optimization of the Transformer architecture is a multi-dimensional problem spanning algorithmic design, numerical efficiency, and hardware-aware implementation. Empirical results consistently demonstrate that these optimizations can reduce training cost by orders of magnitude, extend context length, and improve performance–efficiency trade-offs. As scaling laws continue to hold, such optimizations are essential for sustaining progress in large-scale foundation models and for making Transformer-based systems more accessible and deployable across diverse real-world settings.

instruction: Help me translate this technical content to Chinese.
input: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a paradigm within representation learning that leverages inherent structures in unlabeled data to construct supervisory signals, thereby reducing reliance on large-scale human-annotated datasets. Unlike supervised learning, where labels are externally provided, SSL formulates pretext tasks—such as contrastive prediction, masked token modeling, or temporal ordering—that enable models to learn semantically meaningful embeddings. In computer vision, methods like contrastive learning optimize objectives that maximize agreement between different augmented views of the same instance while minimizing similarity across distinct instances, often using techniques such as InfoNCE loss and momentum encoders. In natural language processing, transformer-based architectures employ masked language modeling or next-sentence prediction to capture syntactic and semantic dependencies. The learned representations are subsequently transferred to downstream tasks through fine-tuning or linear probing, often achieving performance comparable to or exceeding fully supervised approaches. From an optimization perspective, SSL addresses issues of label scarcity and domain shift, improving generalization by exploiting large-scale unlabeled corpora. Moreover, recent advances integrate clustering, predictive coding, and multimodal alignment to enhance representation quality. As a result, self-supervised learning has become a foundational technique in modern deep learning pipelines, particularly for scalable and robust model pretraining across diverse data modalities.
output:
自监督学习（Self-supervised Learning，SSL）是表示学习中的一种范式，它利用无标注数据中固有的结构来构建监督信号，从而降低对大规模人工标注数据集的依赖。不同于由外部提供标签的监督学习，SSL 通过设计预任务（pretext tasks），例如对比预测（contrastive prediction）、掩码标记建模（masked token modeling）或时间顺序建模（temporal ordering），使模型能够学习具有语义意义的嵌入表示。

在计算机视觉领域，对比学习等方法通过优化目标函数，使同一实例的不同增强视图之间的一致性最大化，同时最小化不同实例之间的相似度，常用技术包括 InfoNCE 损失和动量编码器（momentum encoder）。在自然语言处理领域，基于 Transformer 的架构通常采用掩码语言建模（masked language modeling）或下一句预测（next-sentence prediction）来捕获句法和语义依赖关系。

学习得到的表示随后通过微调（fine-tuning）或线性探测（linear probing）迁移到下游任务中，其性能往往可与甚至超过完全监督学习方法。从优化角度来看，SSL 缓解了标签稀缺和领域偏移问题，通过利用大规模无标注语料提升了模型的泛化能力。此外，近年来的研究还将聚类、预测编码（predictive coding）以及多模态对齐（multimodal alignment）等机制融入自监督学习，以进一步提升表示质量。

因此，自监督学习已成为现代深度学习流程中的基础性技术，尤其在跨多种数据模态实现可扩展且鲁棒的模型预训练方面发挥着关键作用。

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input: 零样本学习旨在解决传统监督学习依赖大量标注数据的问题，其核心挑战是在训练阶段未见过的类别上进行有效识别。随着类别规模和开放世界场景的扩大，标注成本和长尾分布使得零样本学习成为计算机视觉与自然语言处理中的重要研究方向。经典零样本学习方法通常通过构建视觉空间与语义空间之间的映射，将已见类别的视觉特征投射到共享的语义表示中。语义信息可以来自人工定义的属性向量、词向量或知识图谱，从而为未见类别提供可泛化的先验约束。近年来，基于生成模型的方法通过条件变分自编码器或生成对抗网络合成未见类别的特征，有效缓解了训练阶段的类别缺失问题。此外，跨模态预训练模型如CLIP利用大规模图文对齐数据，实现了更鲁棒的零样本迁移能力。然而，零样本学习仍面临语义偏移和域偏移等问题，即训练分布与测试分布不一致导致性能下降。综合来看，零样本学习通过引入语义先验和生成式建模，显著提升了模型在未知类别上的泛化能力，为开放世界智能系统提供了关键技术支撑。
output: 零样本学习通过引入语义先验解决未见类别识别问题。其方法包括构建视觉—语义映射、利用属性/词向量/知识图谱，以及通过VAE、GAN等生成模型合成特征。近年来CLIP等跨模态预训练提升了零样本迁移能力，但仍受语义与域偏移影响。

instruction: Translate to English:
input: 自监督学习是一类通过构造伪标签或预文本任务从未标注数据中学习表征的方法。其核心思想是利用数据内在结构定义训练目标，如对比学习中的实例判别、信息最大化，以及掩码语言/视觉建模中的重建损失。模型在大规模数据上预训练，获得具有判别性和迁移性的特征表示，再通过少量标注进行下游任务微调。自监督学习显著降低对人工标注的依赖，提升表示泛化能力与可扩展性，已成为视觉、语音与自然语言处理中的关键范式。
output: Self-supervised learning is a class of methods that learn representations from unlabeled data by constructing pseudo-labels or pretext tasks. Its core idea is to define training objectives by exploiting the intrinsic structure of data, such as instance discrimination and information maximization in contrastive learning, as well as reconstruction losses in masked language or vision modeling. Models are pre-trained on large-scale datasets to obtain discriminative and transferable feature representations, which are then fine-tuned on downstream tasks with a small amount of labeled data. Self-supervised learning significantly reduces reliance on manual annotation, enhances the generalization and scalability of representations, and has become a key paradigm in computer vision, speech processing, and natural language processing.

instruction: 将下文翻译成中文，注意保留技术术语。
input: Optimization of the Transformer architecture has become a central research topic due to its widespread adoption in natural language processing, computer vision, and multimodal learning. One major direction focuses on improving computational efficiency and scalability, particularly addressing the quadratic time and memory complexity of self-attention with respect to sequence length. Techniques such as sparse attention, low-rank factorization, linearized attention mechanisms, and kernel-based approximations aim to reduce this complexity while preserving expressive power. Another line of optimization targets model parameter efficiency through weight sharing, parameter tying, and structured pruning, as well as through low-precision training methods such as mixed-precision arithmetic and quantization-aware training. From an architectural perspective, enhancements including pre-layer normalization, residual scaling, and alternative feed-forward network designs have been shown to stabilize training and improve convergence in deep Transformer stacks. Additionally, adaptive attention span and dynamic routing mechanisms allow the model to allocate computational resources more effectively based on input characteristics. On the optimization algorithm side, advanced learning rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and large-batch training strategies play a crucial role in achieving faster convergence without sacrificing generalization. Collectively, these optimization techniques enable Transformers to scale to billions of parameters and trillions of tokens, significantly improving performance while reducing training and inference costs.
output:
由于 Transformer 架构在自然语言处理、计算机视觉以及多模态学习中的广泛应用，对其进行优化已成为一个核心研究课题。其中一个重要方向是提升计算效率和可扩展性，尤其是针对自注意力机制在序列长度维度上具有二次时间和内存复杂度的问题。稀疏注意力（sparse attention）、低秩分解（low-rank factorization）、线性化注意力机制（linearized attention）以及基于核函数的近似方法（kernel-based approximations）等技术，旨在在保持模型表达能力的同时降低这种复杂度。

另一条优化路径关注模型参数效率，包括通过权重共享（weight sharing）、参数绑定（parameter tying）和结构化剪枝（structured pruning）来减少参数规模，以及采用混合精度计算（mixed-precision arithmetic）和量化感知训练（quantization-aware training）等低精度训练方法。从架构设计角度来看，引入预层归一化（pre-layer normalization）、残差缩放（residual scaling）以及替代性的前馈网络（feed-forward network）设计，已被证明能够稳定深层 Transformer 堆叠的训练过程并改善收敛性。

此外，自适应注意力跨度（adaptive attention span）和动态路由机制（dynamic routing mechanisms）使模型能够根据输入特性更有效地分配计算资源。在优化算法层面，先进的学习率调度策略、自适应优化器以及大批量训练策略，在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下，对实现更快的收敛速度起着关键作用。总体而言，这些优化技术使 Transformer 能够扩展到数十亿参数和数万亿 token 的规模，在显著提升模型性能的同时，有效降低了训练和推理成本。

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input:
Transformer架构在自然语言处理与多模态建模中取得了显著成功，但其自注意力机制在长序列场景下面临计算与存储复杂度为O(n²)的问题，限制了模型在大规模推理与训练中的效率与可扩展性。因此，围绕计算效率、内存占用和建模能力的优化成为研究重点。

在结构层面，研究者提出了多种注意力优化方案，如稀疏注意力、局部注意力和线性注意力，通过约束注意力连接或重构注意力计算形式，将复杂度降低至近似线性。同时，FlashAttention等算子级优化利用显存感知的块化计算与融合算子，显著减少中间张量的读写开销。

在参数与表示层面，引入旋转位置编码（RoPE）、相对位置编码以及多查询注意力（MQA）与分组查询注意力（GQA），在保持建模能力的同时降低KV缓存规模。此外，参数共享、低秩分解与参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）也有效缓解了模型规模增长带来的训练与部署成本。

综合来看，Transformer架构的优化通过算法、系统与表示多层协同，在保证模型性能的前提下显著提升了训练吞吐与推理效率，为长上下文建模和大模型落地提供了关键支撑。这些优化已成为新一代基础模型设计中的核心组成部分。
output: 通过算法、算子与表示协同优化，Transformer在保持性能下显著降低长序列注意力的计算与内存开销。

instruction: Help me translate this to English.
input: 参数高效微调（Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning, PEFT）是一类旨在降低大规模预训练模型下游适配成本的技术范式。其核心思想是在冻结主干模型参数的前提下，仅引入少量可训练参数完成任务迁移，从而显著减少显存占用与计算开销。典型方法包括Adapter、Prefix-Tuning、Prompt-Tuning以及LoRA等，其中LoRA通过低秩分解对注意力权重进行增量建模，在保持模型表达能力的同时提升训练与部署效率。PEFT不仅缓解了全参数微调带来的过拟合与灾难性遗忘问题，也为大模型的多任务、多场景应用提供了可扩展且经济的解决方案。
output: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is a class of techniques aimed at reducing the cost of adapting large-scale pre-trained models to downstream tasks. The core idea is to freeze the backbone model parameters and introduce only a small number of trainable parameters to accomplish task transfer, thereby significantly reducing memory consumption and computational overhead. Representative methods include Adapters, Prefix-Tuning, Prompt-Tuning, and LoRA. Among them, LoRA incrementally models attention weights through low-rank decomposition, improving training and deployment efficiency while preserving the model’s expressive capacity. PEFT not only mitigates overfitting and catastrophic forgetting associated with full-parameter fine-tuning, but also provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for multi-task and multi-scenario applications of large models.

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
随着大规模预训练模型在决策、生成与自治任务中的能力跃升，AI安全与对齐问题逐渐成为制约其规模化部署的核心瓶颈。所谓对齐，是指模型行为与人类价值、意图及社会规范的一致性；失配则可能表现为奖励黑客、目标漂移、越权行动或隐性有害输出，在高自治场景下风险尤为突出。

当前主流方案以价值学习与约束优化为核心。一方面，通过人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）、偏好建模与排序学习，将隐含的人类价值映射为可优化的奖励信号；另一方面，宪法式AI、规则约束解码与安全过滤器用于提供可解释的先验约束。此外，可扩展监督、对抗性红队测试与安全基准评测被用于缓解监督稀缺问题并发现长尾风险。解释性方法（如机制可解释性、因果探测）与鲁棒性训练（如分布外检测、对抗训练）则提升了系统可审计性与稳定性。

综合来看，AI安全与对齐并非单一算法问题，而是涵盖数据、目标、训练与部署全流程的系统工程。未来方向在于将对齐目标内生化为模型能力的一部分，并建立可验证、可迭代的安全评估闭环，以支持更高层级的可靠自治。
output: 大模型能力提升使AI安全与对齐成为规模化部署瓶颈。核心在于通过RLHF、偏好学习与约束优化对齐人类价值，并结合宪法式AI、红队评测、解释性与鲁棒训练，构建贯穿全流程的可验证安全体系。

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
在深度学习模型落地过程中，模型规模与推理效率之间的矛盾日益突出。大模型通常具备更强的表示能力和泛化性能，但其参数量大、计算和存储成本高，难以部署在资源受限的终端环境中。如何在保证性能的同时压缩模型规模，成为模型工程化中的关键问题，知识蒸馏方法由此被提出并得到广泛关注。

知识蒸馏的核心思想是通过教师模型（Teacher）向学生模型（Student）传递知识，使小模型学习到大模型的判别能力。经典方法以响应蒸馏为代表，通过引入带温度系数的软标签，将教师模型输出的类别分布作为监督信号，通常使用KL散度度量学生与教师输出之间的差异。在此基础上，研究者提出了特征蒸馏、中间层蒸馏和关系蒸馏等方法，将隐藏特征、注意力映射或样本间关系作为蒸馏目标。此外，自蒸馏、在线蒸馏和多教师蒸馏等变体进一步提升了训练稳定性和知识利用效率。

实验结果表明，合理设计的蒸馏策略能够在显著减少参数量和计算量的情况下，使学生模型性能接近甚至超过教师模型。知识蒸馏已在图像识别、语音识别和自然语言处理等任务中得到验证，为高效模型部署提供了一条可行且通用的技术路径。
output: 知识蒸馏通过教师向学生传递多层次知识，实现模型压缩下的高效高性能部署。

instruction: 简要总结以下技术文章的核心论点。
input:
Sentiment analysis algorithms aim to automatically identify and quantify subjective information expressed in text, such as opinions, emotions, and attitudes. With the rapid growth of user-generated content on social media, e-commerce platforms, and online forums, sentiment analysis has become a core task in natural language processing (NLP). It supports downstream applications including brand monitoring, recommendation systems, financial forecasting, and public opinion analysis. The primary challenge lies in modeling the complexity of human language, which involves ambiguity, context dependence, sarcasm, and domain-specific semantics.

Early approaches to sentiment analysis were predominantly lexicon-based. These methods rely on predefined sentiment dictionaries that assign polarity scores to words or phrases. Sentiment polarity of a document is computed by aggregating the scores of matched terms, often with heuristic rules for negation and intensification. While lexicon-based methods are interpretable and require no labeled data, they suffer from limited coverage and poor adaptability to new domains. They also struggle with contextual sentiment shifts and compositional semantics.

Supervised machine learning approaches significantly improved performance by learning sentiment patterns from labeled data. Traditional models such as Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machines, and Logistic Regression represent text using features like bag-of-words, n-grams, or TF-IDF vectors. These methods capture statistical correlations between lexical features and sentiment labels, achieving robust results on benchmark datasets. However, they depend heavily on feature engineering and fail to model long-range dependencies and semantic relationships.

Recent advances in deep learning have transformed sentiment analysis. Neural architectures such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), particularly Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, learn distributed representations of text via word embeddings. These models can capture syntactic and semantic patterns more effectively than traditional methods. The current state of the art is dominated by transformer-based models, including BERT, RoBERTa, and GPT-style architectures. By leveraging self-attention mechanisms and large-scale pretraining on unlabeled corpora, transformers provide contextualized embeddings that adapt word meaning to surrounding context, enabling fine-grained sentiment classification and aspect-based sentiment analysis.

Model performance is typically evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score on standard datasets like IMDb, SST, or SemEval benchmarks. Empirical results consistently show that pretrained transformer models fine-tuned on task-specific data outperform earlier approaches, especially in handling nuanced sentiment and contextual polarity. Nevertheless, challenges remain, including data bias, domain transferability, computational cost, and explainability.

In conclusion, sentiment analysis algorithms have evolved from rule-based systems to sophisticated deep learning models that leverage large-scale data and contextual representations. While modern approaches achieve high accuracy, future research is expected to focus on efficiency, robustness across domains, low-resource learning, and interpretable sentiment modeling to support trustworthy real-world applications.
output: 情感分析旨在自动识别文本中的主观情绪信息，已从词典规则方法发展到机器学习与深度学习模型。当前以BERT等Transformer为主，利用上下文建模显著提升性能，但仍面临可解释性、领域迁移和计算成本等挑战。

instruction: Help me translate this technical content to Chinese.
input: Model compression and quantization techniques are critical for deploying deep neural networks in resource-constrained environments by reducing model size, memory footprint, and inference latency while preserving accuracy. Model compression encompasses a spectrum of methods, including unstructured and structured pruning to remove redundant weights or channels, low-rank matrix factorization to exploit parameter redundancy, weight sharing and Huffman coding for entropy reduction, and knowledge distillation, where a compact student model is trained to mimic the soft targets of a larger teacher network. Quantization further improves efficiency by representing weights and activations with reduced numerical precision, such as INT8 or even INT4, instead of 32-bit floating point. Common approaches include post-training quantization, which applies quantization after model training using calibration data, and quantization-aware training (QAT), which simulates quantization effects during training to mitigate accuracy degradation. Advanced schemes leverage per-channel quantization, mixed-precision arithmetic, and symmetric or asymmetric scaling to better handle activation distributions and outliers. From a systems perspective, these techniques significantly reduce memory bandwidth requirements and energy consumption, and they align well with modern hardware accelerators that provide optimized integer arithmetic units. However, achieving an optimal accuracy–efficiency trade-off requires careful consideration of error propagation, activation clipping strategies, and hardware-specific constraints, making model compression and quantization an active area of research and engineering.
output: 模型压缩与量化技术对于在资源受限环境中部署深度神经网络至关重要，它们通过在尽量保持模型精度的前提下降低模型规模、内存占用和推理延迟来实现高效部署。模型压缩涵盖了一系列方法，包括非结构化和结构化剪枝，用于移除冗余权重或通道；低秩矩阵分解，用以挖掘参数冗余；权重共享与 Huffman 编码，以降低模型熵；以及知识蒸馏，通过训练一个紧凑的 student 模型来模仿大型 teacher 网络的软目标输出。量化则通过使用较低数值精度（如 INT8 甚至 INT4）来表示权重和激活值，取代 32 位浮点表示，从而进一步提升计算效率。常见的量化方法包括训练后量化（post-training quantization），即在模型训练完成后利用校准数据进行量化，以及量化感知训练（quantization-aware training，QAT），在训练过程中模拟量化效应以缓解精度下降。更先进的方案还利用按通道量化、混合精度计算以及对称或非对称缩放策略，以更好地应对激活分布和异常值。从系统角度来看，这些技术能够显著降低内存带宽需求和能耗，并且与提供优化整数运算单元的现代硬件加速器高度契合。然而，实现精度与效率之间的最优权衡需要综合考虑误差传播、激活裁剪策略以及硬件相关约束，这也使得模型压缩与量化成为一个持续活跃的研究与工程领域。

instruction: 请总结以下技术文档的核心内容。
input:
Neural network pruning has emerged as a critical technique for addressing the growing computational and memory demands of deep learning models, particularly in resource-constrained environments such as edge devices and real-time systems. Modern deep neural networks are often heavily overparameterized, leading to redundancy in weights, neurons, or channels. While this overparameterization can facilitate optimization and generalization during training, it results in inefficient inference, increased latency, and higher energy consumption. Pruning aims to remove unnecessary components from a trained or partially trained model while preserving predictive performance.

Pruning strategies can be broadly categorized into unstructured and structured approaches. Unstructured pruning removes individual weights based on some importance criterion, typically resulting in sparse weight matrices. A common method is magnitude-based pruning, where weights with small absolute values are assumed to contribute less to the output and are set to zero. More advanced criteria rely on sensitivity analysis, such as first- or second-order Taylor expansions of the loss function, to estimate the impact of removing a parameter. Although unstructured pruning can achieve high sparsity with minimal accuracy loss, it often requires specialized hardware or sparse computation libraries to translate sparsity into real-world speedups.

Structured pruning, in contrast, removes higher-level components such as filters, channels, attention heads, or even entire layers. Channel pruning in convolutional neural networks is a representative example, where channels are ranked using criteria such as L1/L2 norms, batch normalization scaling factors, or group sparsity regularization (e.g., Group Lasso). Structured pruning produces dense sub-networks that are more compatible with standard hardware accelerators and compilers, making it attractive for deployment. However, it typically involves a more complex design space and may lead to larger accuracy degradation if structural dependencies are not carefully considered.

Another line of research focuses on training-aware and dynamic pruning strategies. The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis suggests that within a dense network exists a sparse subnetwork that can be trained to comparable accuracy when initialized appropriately. Building on this idea, iterative pruning and retraining schedules have been proposed. More recent methods integrate pruning into the training process via sparsity-inducing regularization or dynamic masks that evolve during optimization, reducing the need for costly post-training fine-tuning.

Empirical results show that well-designed pruning strategies can significantly reduce model size, floating-point operations (FLOPs), and inference latency with marginal or no loss in accuracy. In some cases, pruning even improves generalization by reducing overfitting. Nevertheless, the effectiveness of pruning is highly dependent on the model architecture, task, and target hardware. As a result, future research is increasingly focused on hardware-aware pruning, automated pruning via neural architecture search, and the co-design of pruning algorithms with efficient compilers and runtimes.
output: 神经网络剪枝通过移除冗余权重或结构以降低模型计算与存储开销。方法包括非结构化剪枝（权重级稀疏）和结构化剪枝（通道/层级裁剪），以及训练感知与动态剪枝。合理剪枝可在保持精度的同时减少参数量、FLOPs 和延迟，未来趋势聚焦硬件感知与自动化剪枝。

instruction: Translate to Chinese:
input: Loss function design is a central component in the development and optimization of machine learning models, as it formally defines the training objective and directly influences convergence behavior, generalization performance, and model robustness. A well-designed loss function provides a differentiable and well-conditioned optimization landscape that aligns closely with the underlying task metrics. In supervised learning, common losses such as mean squared error, cross-entropy, and hinge loss are derived from probabilistic assumptions or margin-based principles, but practical applications often require customized formulations. Advanced loss design may incorporate regularization terms to control model complexity, such as L1 or L2 penalties, or structured constraints to encode domain knowledge. In deep learning, composite losses are frequently employed, combining multiple objectives (e.g., classification accuracy, reconstruction fidelity, and auxiliary tasks) with carefully tuned weighting coefficients. Robust loss functions, such as Huber loss or focal loss, are introduced to mitigate the impact of outliers, class imbalance, or noisy labels. Moreover, recent research explores adaptive and dynamic loss functions, where parameters evolve during training to improve optimization stability or sample efficiency. From an optimization perspective, properties such as smoothness, convexity (or controlled non-convexity), and gradient scale play a critical role in ensuring stable backpropagation and efficient convergence when using gradient-based methods.

instruction: 把这段话翻成中文。
input: Loss function design is a critical component in machine learning and deep learning systems, as it defines the optimization objective that guides model training. A well-designed loss function quantitatively measures the discrepancy between model predictions and ground-truth targets, thereby shaping the gradient signals used by optimization algorithms such as stochastic gradient descent. The choice of loss function must align with the task characteristics, data distribution, and evaluation metrics. For example, cross-entropy loss is widely used in classification tasks due to its strong theoretical connection to maximum likelihood estimation, while mean squared error is commonly applied in regression problems under Gaussian noise assumptions. Beyond standard formulations, advanced loss function design often incorporates regularization terms, such as L1 or L2 penalties, to control model complexity and improve generalization. In structured prediction and metric learning, margin-based losses (e.g., hinge loss, triplet loss) are employed to enforce relative constraints in the embedding space. Additionally, modern deep learning applications frequently rely on custom or composite loss functions, combining multiple objectives to balance competing goals such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, or interpretability. Differentiability, numerical stability, and gradient smoothness are also essential considerations, as poorly behaved loss landscapes can lead to vanishing or exploding gradients. Ultimately, effective loss function design requires both theoretical insight and empirical validation, playing a decisive role in model performance and convergence behavior.
output: 损失函数设计是机器学习和深度学习系统中的关键组成部分，因为它定义了指导模型训练的优化目标。一个设计良好的损失函数能够定量衡量模型预测与真实标注（ground-truth）之间的差异，从而塑造优化算法（如随机梯度下降，stochastic gradient descent）所使用的梯度信号。损失函数的选择必须与具体任务特性、数据分布以及评估指标相一致。例如，交叉熵损失（cross-entropy loss）由于与最大似然估计（maximum likelihood estimation）具有坚实的理论联系，被广泛应用于分类任务；而在高斯噪声假设下，均方误差（mean squared error）通常用于回归问题。除了标准形式之外，高级损失函数设计往往会引入正则化项，如 L1 或 L2 惩罚，以控制模型复杂度并提升泛化能力。在结构化预测（structured prediction）和度量学习（metric learning）中，常采用基于间隔的损失函数（如 hinge loss、triplet loss），以在嵌入空间中施加相对约束。此外，现代深度学习应用中经常依赖自定义或复合损失函数，通过组合多个目标来平衡诸如准确性、鲁棒性、公平性或可解释性等相互竞争的需求。可微性、数值稳定性以及梯度平滑性同样是重要考量因素，因为不良的损失函数形态可能导致梯度消失或梯度爆炸。总体而言，有效的损失函数设计既需要理论洞察，也依赖于经验验证，并在模型性能和收敛行为中发挥决定性作用。

the existence and uniqueness of solutions to the differential equations of physics is seldom an issue . 
 the very fact that these equations describe physical reality seems to argue that their solutions must exist and be unique . 
 textbook examples of nonuniqueness , for example clairaut s equation ( ref . 
 @xcite , p. 94 ) , seem like exceptional cases , which would not arise in physics in any case .    there is , however , a system of differential equations , arising as a limiting case of a much studied physical problem , in which uniqueness fails for _ every _ solution at _ every _ time . 
 the system is singular laplacian growth @xcite , @xcite . 
 one might call this behavior `` maximally nonunique . '' 
 it is so different from the usual behavior of differential equations that it hardly seems like a differential system at all . 
 the way it occurs is the following : the theory of singular laplacian growth describes the motions of certain singularities of a conformal map , which are all located on the unit circle in the complex plane . 
 they move on the circle , but they can also `` split , '' introducing new singularities , at any time . 
 this behavior , which does not sound very remarkable , essentially implies the maximal nonuniqueness property . in ref . 
 @xcite the term `` fragile '' was suggested for such a system , because its distinguishing feature is that its singularities can break apart . 
 it is natural to ask if other physical systems might reduce to a fragile system in some limit , and if the fragile property manifests itself in the behavior of the system . 
 turbulence is certainly a candidate to be a fragile system : like laplacian growth , turbulence is a phenomenon in which a differential equation has unexpectedly complex solutions . in this paper 
 i argue that turbulence is a system that has a fragile ( maximally nonunique ) limiting case . 
 the limiting case is the burgers equation .

output: GPU parallel computing leverages massively parallel multiprocessor architectures to achieve high-throughput computation across tens of thousands of threads via the SIMT execution model. Programming models represented by CUDA and OpenCL organize threads into warps, blocks, and grids, and hide memory access latency through scheduling and occupancy management. Performance optimization relies on effective utilization of the memory hierarchy, including coalesced global memory accesses, shared memory reuse, and control of register pressure. Algorithm design must account for data parallelism, branch divergence, and synchronization overhead to increase arithmetic intensity. At the system level, Amdahl’s law and performance analysis tools are also required to identify bottlenecks and balance computation and bandwidth.

instruction: English translation:
input: 特征工程是将原始数据转化为可被模型有效利用表示的关键过程，直接影响模型的泛化性能。常见方法包括特征清洗与缺失值处理、数值特征的标准化与归一化、类别特征的独热编码与目标编码，以及基于统计量或信息论的特征选择。针对时序与文本数据，还可通过窗口化、n-gram、TF-IDF或嵌入表示进行构造。在高维场景中，主成分分析、自动编码器等降维技术用于缓解维度灾难并降低噪声。结合领域知识进行特征交叉与非线性变换，能够显著提升模型表达能力与稳定性。
output: Feature engineering is a critical process that transforms raw data into representations that can be effectively leveraged by models, directly impacting their generalization performance. Common techniques include feature cleaning and missing value handling, standardization and normalization of numerical features, one-hot encoding and target encoding for categorical features, and feature selection based on statistical measures or information-theoretic criteria. For time-series and text data, features can be constructed through windowing, n-grams, TF-IDF, or embedding representations. In high-dimensional settings, dimensionality reduction methods such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and autoencoders are employed to mitigate the curse of dimensionality and reduce noise. Incorporating domain knowledge through feature crossing and nonlinear transformations can significantly enhance a model’s expressive power and stability.

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
Large-scale pre-trained models, particularly Transformer-based architectures, have become the foundation of modern natural language processing and multimodal systems. While these models exhibit strong generalization capabilities, adapting them to downstream tasks traditionally requires full fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive and memory-intensive. Full fine-tuning also introduces challenges related to model storage, deployment, and catastrophic forgetting when multiple task-specific variants are maintained. These limitations motivate parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques, among which Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a widely adopted and effective solution.

LoRA is based on the observation that weight updates during fine-tuning often lie in a low-rank subspace. Instead of updating the full weight matrices of a pre-trained model, LoRA injects trainable low-rank matrices into selected layers—typically the linear projections in attention modules such as query, key, and value matrices. Formally, for a weight matrix \(W \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times k}\), LoRA freezes \(W\) and represents the update \(\Delta W\) as the product of two low-rank matrices \(A \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times r}\) and \(B \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times k}\), where \(r \ll \min(d, k)\). During training, only \(A\) and \(B\) are optimized, while the original parameters remain unchanged. At inference time, the low-rank update can be merged with the base weights or applied dynamically, depending on deployment constraints.

This design yields several practical advantages. First, the number of trainable parameters is reduced by orders of magnitude, significantly lowering GPU memory consumption and enabling fine-tuning on consumer-grade hardware. Second, LoRA adapters are modular: multiple task- or domain-specific adapters can be stored and swapped without duplicating the base model, which is especially beneficial in multi-tenant or continual learning scenarios. Third, freezing the backbone weights improves training stability and reduces the risk of overfitting, particularly when labeled data is scarce.

Empirical results across tasks such as text classification, machine translation, instruction tuning, and diffusion-based image generation demonstrate that LoRA achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning while using less than 1–5% of the trainable parameters. Moreover, LoRA integrates seamlessly with existing optimization pipelines and is compatible with mixed-precision training and distributed systems. Variants and extensions, including adaptive rank selection and combination with other PEFT methods, further enhance its flexibility.

In conclusion, LoRA adapters provide a principled and efficient approach to model adaptation by leveraging low-rank parameterization. They strike a favorable balance between performance, resource efficiency, and deployment flexibility, making them a key enabling technique for scaling the customization of large pre-trained models in both research and production environments.
output: LoRA 是一种参数高效微调方法，通过在冻结的预训练模型中引入低秩矩阵，仅训练少量参数即可适配下游任务。其显著降低计算与存储成本，支持模块化部署，在多任务场景下性能接近全量微调。

input: 在机器学习与深度学习模型中，随着模型容量的提升和特征维度的增加，过拟合问题日益突出，即模型在训练集上表现良好但泛化能力不足。其根源在于模型复杂度过高导致方差增大，破坏了偏差—方差平衡，因此引入正则化技术成为提升泛化性能的关键手段。常见方法包括参数正则化与结构正则化，其中L2正则化（Ridge）通过在损失函数中加入权重平方惩罚项，抑制参数过大，从而平滑模型；L1正则化（Lasso）则利用稀疏约束实现特征选择，适合高维稀疏场景，Elastic Net进一步结合二者优势。在深度学习中，权重衰减本质上等价于L2正则化，Dropout通过随机失活神经元降低共适应风险，Early Stopping则依据验证集误差提前终止训练。此外，从贝叶斯视角看，正则化可解释为对参数先验分布的约束。实践表明，合理的正则化策略能够有效降低过拟合风险，提高模型稳定性与泛化能力，是构建高性能学习系统的重要组成部分。
output: 模型复杂度提升易致过拟合，源于方差增大。正则化通过约束参数或结构提升泛化能力：L2抑制权重，L1促稀疏与特征选择，Elastic Net结合二者；深度学习中权重衰减、Dropout与Early Stopping常用，贝叶斯视角等价于参数先验约束。

instruction: 请翻译以下AI领域的文本。
input: Image generation models aim to learn the underlying data distribution of visual content and synthesize high-fidelity images through probabilistic or implicit generative processes. Classical approaches such as Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) model images via a latent variable framework optimized through the evidence lower bound (ELBO), enabling efficient inference but often producing over-smoothed outputs due to Gaussian assumptions. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) address this limitation by introducing an adversarial objective between a generator and a discriminator, achieving sharp and realistic images at the cost of training instability and mode collapse. More recently, diffusion-based models, including Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) and score-based generative models, have become dominant due to their stable training dynamics and strong likelihood-based foundations. These models iteratively transform noise into data by learning the reverse of a stochastic diffusion process, often guided by score matching and enhanced through classifier or text-conditioned guidance. Latent diffusion further improves computational efficiency by operating in a compressed latent space learned via autoencoders. Transformer-based architectures and multimodal conditioning, such as CLIP-aligned text-image embeddings, have significantly advanced controllable and semantic image synthesis. Model performance is typically evaluated using perceptual metrics like Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS), though these metrics have known limitations. Overall, modern image generation models balance fidelity, diversity, scalability, and controllability, driven by advances in representation learning, optimization, and large-scale data and compute.
output: 图像生成模型旨在学习视觉内容的潜在数据分布，并通过概率式或隐式的生成过程合成高保真图像。经典方法如变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoders，VAEs）通过潜变量框架对图像进行建模，并利用证据下界（Evidence Lower Bound，ELBO）进行优化，从而实现高效推断，但由于高斯分布假设，往往会产生过度平滑的输出。生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Networks，GANs）通过在生成器与判别器之间引入对抗目标来克服这一局限，能够生成清晰且逼真的图像，但代价是训练过程不稳定以及模式崩溃问题。近年来，基于扩散的模型，包括去噪扩散概率模型（Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models，DDPMs）和基于 score 的生成模型，因其稳定的训练动力学和坚实的似然建模基础而占据主导地位。这类模型通过学习随机扩散过程的逆过程，将噪声逐步转化为数据，通常结合 score matching，并通过分类器引导或文本条件引导进行增强。潜空间扩散（Latent Diffusion）通过在由自编码器学习得到的压缩潜空间中进行操作，进一步提升了计算效率。基于 Transformer 的架构以及多模态条件机制（如与 CLIP 对齐的文本–图像嵌入）显著推动了可控且具备语义一致性的图像合成发展。模型性能通常使用感知指标进行评估，如 Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）和 Inception Score（IS），但这些指标本身也存在已知局限性。总体而言，现代图像生成模型在保真度、多样性、可扩展性与可控性之间取得平衡，这一进展得益于表示学习、优化方法以及大规模数据与计算资源的持续发展。

instruction: 请把这段中文翻译成英文。
input: Transformer架构的优化主要围绕计算复杂度、内存占用与训练稳定性展开。一方面，通过稀疏注意力、低秩分解与FlashAttention等技术，将自注意力的时间与空间复杂度从O(n²)有效压缩；结合KV Cache与序列并行策略，可显著提升长序列建模与推理效率。另一方面，在模型结构层面引入参数共享、混合专家（MoE）机制，以及权重量化与结构化剪枝，在保持性能的同时降低参数规模与算力需求。此外，改进的位置编码方案、预归一化设计与残差连接路径有助于缓解梯度消失问题并加速收敛，从而支持大规模Transformer模型的高效训练与工程化部署。
output: Optimization of the Transformer architecture primarily focuses on computational complexity, memory footprint, and training stability. On one hand, techniques such as sparse attention, low-rank decomposition, and FlashAttention effectively compress the time and space complexity of self-attention from O(n²); when combined with KV cache mechanisms and sequence parallelism strategies, they significantly improve long-sequence modeling and inference efficiency. On the other hand, at the architectural level, introducing parameter sharing, mixture-of-experts (MoE) mechanisms, as well as weight quantization and structured pruning, reduces parameter counts and computational requirements while maintaining performance. In addition, improved positional encoding schemes, pre-normalization designs, and optimized residual connection pathways help mitigate gradient vanishing and accelerate convergence, thereby enabling efficient training and engineering deployment of large-scale Transformer models.

instruction: 概括下文的主要内容和贡献。
input: 命名实体识别（Named Entity Recognition，NER）是自然语言处理中的核心任务之一，目标是在非结构化文本中识别并分类具有特定语义的实体，如人名、地名、组织机构、时间和专有名词等。该任务是信息抽取、知识图谱构建和问答系统的重要基础，其性能直接影响下游应用的整体效果。早期NER方法主要基于规则和词典，依赖人工设计特征，具有可解释性但泛化能力有限。随后，统计学习方法将NER建模为序列标注问题，典型模型包括隐马尔可夫模型和条件随机场（CRF），并常采用BIO标注体系进行实体边界建模。随着深度学习的发展，基于神经网络的方法成为主流，如BiLSTM-CRF模型能够同时捕获上下文语义和标签依赖关系。近年来，Transformer架构和预训练语言模型（如BERT、RoBERTa）显著提升了NER性能，通过上下文相关表示缓解了歧义和长距离依赖问题。此外，研究者还提出了基于span的建模方式、领域词表融合和跨领域迁移学习，以应对低资源和领域适配挑战。实验结果表明，现代NER模型在标准数据集上取得了较高的Precision、Recall和F1值，但在复杂语境和噪声文本中仍存在改进空间。总体而言，NER技术正朝着高鲁棒性、低标注成本和领域自适应方向持续演进。
output: 命名实体识别是信息抽取的核心任务，目标从文本中识别并分类实体。方法由规则和统计模型（HMM、CRF）发展到深度学习的BiLSTM-CRF和基于Transformer的预训练模型。新研究通过span建模、迁移学习提升性能，但复杂语境和噪声文本仍具挑战。
